issuer.summary: USG is issued by Tangent Finance, a sub-$5M and roughly four-month-old issuer — the youngest and smallest behind any asset tracked here. Governance is announced but not live: the protocol is still pre-token, so there is no operating governance process today and decisions rest with the team. The audit set is genuinely strong for the protocol's age, which is why this axis is not lower, though one audit's two High and fourteen Medium findings have remediation that is unconfirmed rather than disputed. Contract-authority risk is priced separately. See the full report.
issuer.summary_source: Internal assessment of issuer age, size, governance status and audit coverage. Remediation status is unconfirmed rather than verified. [verified 2026-09-06]
